triples.subject: nginx logs
triples.source_text: To rotate the nginx logs on the web host, first stop the service with `systemctl stop nginx`.

triples.subject: current logs
triples.source_text: `tar -czf /backup/nginx-logs-$(date +%F).tar.gz /var/log/nginx`

triples.subject: log directory
triples.source_text: `rm /var/log/nginx/*.log`

triples.subject: nginx service
triples.source_text: and start the service again using `systemctl start nginx`.

triples.subject: service status
triples.source_text: You can verify it came back with `systemctl status nginx`.
